text: t[1] When Israel was a child I loved him, [AA]out of Egypt [2] I called my son. [AB]
The more I called them,the farther they went from me,Sacrificing to the Baalsand burning incense to idols.
Yet it was I who taught Ephraim to walk,who took them in my arms; [AC]but they did not know that I cared for them.
I drew them with human cords,with bands of love; [3]I fostered them like thosewho raise an infant to their cheeks;I bent down to feed them. [AD]
He shall return to the land of Egypt, [AE]Assyria shall be his king,because they have refused to repent.
The sword shall rage in his cities:it shall destroy his diviners,and devour them because of their schemings.
My people have their mind set on apostasy;though they call on God in unison,he shall not raise them up.
How could I give you up, Ephraim,or deliver you up, Israel?How could I treat you as Admah,or make you like Zeboiim? [4] [AF]My heart is overwhelmed,my pity is stirred.
I will not give vent to my blazing anger,I will not destroy Ephraim again;For I am God and not a man, [AG]the Holy One present among you;I will not come in wrath.
They shall follow the Lord,who roars like a lion; [AH]When he roars,his children shall come frightened from the west,
Out of Egypt they shall come trembling, like birds,like doves, from the land of Assyria;And I will resettle them in their homes,oracle of the Lord.
